BiblicalUsage: Zehar is the Aramaic word for taking heed, being warned before it is too late. King Artaxerxes writes to his officials in the days of Ezra and warns them to take heed that they fail not in stopping the rebuilding of Jerusalem, lest damage grow to the hurt of the kings.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that a warning is a mercy, because it comes before the damage and gives us time to turn.
